engine: Springs terrace CAROUSEL — arrow-driven portrait carousel; slides change by a VERTICAL SLICE/PUSH inside a fixed frame, copy crossfading a beat behind, each slide Ken-Burns drifting. Harvested from D_springs_nature_and_carousel.

measured_teardown.frame: a fixed portrait IMAGE FRAME (~480x475 @1280w, ~0.66-1.0 ratio, overflow:hidden); image inside larger than the frame, slow Ken-Burns drift.
measured_teardown.transition: VERTICAL slice/push (NOT crossfade, NOT horizontal, NOT clip-X). NEXT(->): incoming slides UP from the BOTTOM (translateY 100%->0), outgoing rides up/off. PREV(<-): incoming enters from the TOP. ~0.7-0.85s.
measured_teardown.copy: 3-line caption right column; crossfades a beat AFTER the image (picture lands first, words confirm second) — proven f_089 both texts ghosted mid-swap.
measured_teardown.controls: two outline circular <- -> buttons (~38px, 1px stroke cream ~50%), hover-brighten.
measured_teardown.bg: deep-green plate with a subtle upper radial lighten.

copyLagMs.what: delay before the copy crossfade starts (a beat after the image).

kenBurns.what: ambient slow scale/translate drift on each slide image (off under reduced-motion).

entry: PortraitCarousel.init(target, opts) -> { go(dir), current(), slides }. Markup-first: .pc-slide children carry data-image/data-copy; engine builds the 2-layer push frame, wires .pc-prev/.pc-next, drives copy. Arrow keys also cycle.
law: transform (image push + ken-burns) + opacity (copy crossfade) only; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the moving image; reduced-motion -> hard swap + no ken-burns; click + keyboard. NO WebGL.
vs_persistent_index_menu: both use a 2-layer vertical push, but portrait-carousel is ARROW/sequential (next/prev, loops, PREV reverses direction) in a portrait frame with Ken-Burns, vs the menu's CLICK-a-named-index (non-linear, fixed list, no ken-burns).
gate_mode: CURTAIN/SLICER (CURTAIN=1): the push shows two image layers during the swap = the technique; blank/jank/fps stay hard.
proven: lab: OUR terrace renders in a 0.66 portrait frame + Ukrainian captions + circular controls on a deep-green plate.
